name: infographic-structure-creator
title_zh: 给信息图结构件补位，五种布局随取随用
tagline_zh: 在 antvis/Infographic 里写 TSX 结构组件，列表、对比、时序、层级、关系五类布局。
tagline_en: For antvis/Infographic: build or update structure components—list, compare, sequence, hierarchy, relation—with.
desc_en: Generate or update infographic Structure components for this repo (TypeScript/TSX in src/designs/structures). Use when asked to design, implement, or modify structure layouts (list/compare/sequence/hierarchy/relation/geo/chart), including layout logic, component composition, and registration.
why_zh: 它把结构组件的布局逻辑、组件组合和注册流程打包成一套可复用流程，改一处就能同步更新整个结构体系。
why_en: It bundles layout logic, component composition, and registration into one repeatable flow—change one spot and the whole.
limit_zh: 只认 antvis/Infographic 仓库的 TypeScript/TSX 结构件，不碰其他项目；只覆盖结构层。
limit_en: Only for antvis/Infographic TSX structure files; no visual styling or data binding; requires the repo already set up locally.
title_en: Infographic structure creator: fill missing layout.
